# load packages 
```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggnewscale)
library(colorspace)
library(gridExtra)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(gridExtra)

```

# load data
```{r}
trait_data1<- read.csv("yuba-phys-prepped-field-data-2024_2025.csv")

# subset data frame by species 
ABCO <- trait_data1[trait_data1$species == 'ABCO',]
PILA <- trait_data1[trait_data1$species == 'PILA',]
PIPO <- trait_data1[trait_data1$species == 'PIPO',]
ABMA <- trait_data1[trait_data1$species == 'ABMA',]

```

```{r}
# specify color palette 
species_colors <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(4, "Dark2"),
  c("ABCO", "ABMA", "PIPO", "PILA")
)


line_colors <- colorspace::darken(species_colors, amount = 0.1)

species_list <- list(
  "ABCO" = ABCO,
  "ABMA" = ABMA,
  "PIPO" = PIPO,
  "PILA" = PILA
)

species_list_elev <- list(
  "ABCO" = ABCO,
  "PIPO" = PIPO,
  "PILA" = PILA
)
```

# Figure 1 - WP x diameter
```{r}
### FIGURE 1A: Predawn by size
## plotting model fit trend lines and raw data points

all_preds_1A <- data.frame()
model_summaries_1A <- data.frame()

for (sp in names(species_list)) {
  df <- species_list[[sp]]

  # Fit species-specific model
  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    mod <- lmer(predawn_MPa_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df)
  } else {
    mod <- lmer(predawn_MPa_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df)
  }

  # Extract fixed-effect p-value for diameter
  summ <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  diam_p <- summ["diameter_complete_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  diam_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
  diam_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
  TRUE          ~ "Not significant"
)

  model_summaries_1A <- dplyr::bind_rows(model_summaries_1A,
                                      data.frame(species = sp,
                                                 p_value = diam_p,
                                                 signif = signif_label))

  # Compute mean and SD for scaling diameter
  mean_d <- mean(df$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_d   <- sd(df$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Sequence of diameters
  diam_seq <- seq(min(df$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(df$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
                  length.out = 100)

  # Prediction data
  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    newdata <- data.frame(
      diameter_complete_scaled = (diam_seq - mean_d)/sd_d,
      canopy_closure_scaled = 0
    )
  } else {
    newdata <- data.frame(
      diameter_complete_scaled = (diam_seq - mean_d)/sd_d,
      canopy_closure_scaled = 0,
      elevation_ft_scaled = 0
    )
  }

  newdata$diameter_cm <- diam_seq
  newdata$pred <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif <- signif_label

  all_preds_1A <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds_1A, newdata)
}

### FIGURE 1A: Predawn WP by size
Fig1A <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = trait_data1,
             aes(x = diameter_complete, y = predawn_MPa_combined, color = species),
             alpha = 0.15, size = 2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_line(
  data = all_preds_1A,
  aes(x = diameter_cm, y = pred,
      color = species,
      linetype = signif),
  size = 1.2,
  na.rm = TRUE
)+
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors) +
scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
  "Significant"     = "solid",
  "Marginal"        = "dashed",
  "Not significant" = "dotted"
)) +
  scale_y_reverse(
  labels = function(x) paste0("\u2212", x)
) +
  labs(
    x = "Basal diameter (cm)",
    y = expression(Psi[predawn]~"(MPa)")
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray50", fill = NA, size = 1),  
    panel.grid = element_blank(),       
    axis.line = element_blank(),        
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

Fig1A

  }

)

  # Prediction data

  newdata <- data.frame(

} else {

}

  newdata$diameter_cm <- diam_seq
```

## predawn
```{r}
### FIGURE 2B: P50 by predawn 
## plotting model fit trend lines and raw data points

all_preds_2B <- data.frame()
model_summaries_2B <- data.frame()

for (sp in names(species_list)) {
  df <- species_list[[sp]]

  # Fit species-specific model
  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    mod <- lmer(P50_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled +
                  (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df)
  } else {
    mod <- lmer(P50_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled +
                  elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df)
  }

  # Extract fixed-effect p-value for predawn
  summ <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  pd_p <- summ["predawn_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  pd_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
  pd_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",

)

                                      data.frame(species = sp,
                                                 p_value = pd_p,
                                                 signif = signif_label))

  # Compute mean and SD for scaling predawn
```

## canopy closure
```{r}
### FIGURE 2C: P50_combined by canopy closure 
## plotting model fit trend lines and raw data points

all_preds_2C <- data.frame()
model_summaries_2C <- data.frame()

for (sp in names(species_list)) {
  df <- species_list[[sp]]

  # Fit species-specific model
  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    mod <- lmer(P50_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled +
                  (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df)
  } else {
    mod <- lmer(P50_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled +
                  elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df)
  }

  # Extract fixed-effect p-value for canopy closure
  summ <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  cc_p <- summ["canopy_closure_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  cc_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
  cc_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
  TRUE          ~ "Not significant"
)

  model_summaries_2C <- dplyr::bind_rows(model_summaries_2C,
                                      data.frame(species = sp,
                                                 p_value = cc_p,
                                                 signif = signif_label))

  # Compute mean and SD for scaling percent cover
  mean_cc <- mean(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_cc   <- sd(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Sequence of percent cover values
  cc_seq <- seq(min(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE),
                max(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = 100)

  # Prediction data
  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    newdata <- data.frame(
      canopy_closure_scaled = (cc_seq - mean_cc)/sd_cc,
      diameter_complete_scaled = 0,
      predawn_scaled = 0
    )
  } else {
    newdata <- data.frame(
      canopy_closure_scaled = (cc_seq - mean_cc)/sd_cc,
      diameter_complete_scaled = 0,
      predawn_scaled = 0,
      elevation_ft_scaled = 0
    )
  }

  newdata$canopy_closure <- cc_seq
  newdata$pred <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif <- signif_label

  all_preds_2C <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds_2C, newdata)
}
```

## elevation
```{r}
### FIGURE 2D: P50 by elevation
## plotting model fit trend lines and raw data points
all_preds_2D <- data.frame()
model_summaries_2D <- data.frame()

for (sp in names(species_list_elev)) {
  df <- species_list_elev[[sp]]

  # Fit model
  mod <- lmer(P50_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df)

  # Extract fixed-effect p-value for elevation
  summ <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  elev_p <- summ["elevation_ft_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  elev_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
  elev_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
  TRUE          ~ "Not significant"
)

  model_summaries_2D <- dplyr::bind_rows(model_summaries_2D,
                                      data.frame(species = sp,
                                                 p_value = elev_p,
                                                 signif = signif_label))

  # Compute mean and SD for scaling elevation
  mean_elev <- mean(df$elevation_ft, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_elev   <- sd(df$elevation_ft, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Sequence of elevations
  elev_seq <- seq(min(df$elevation_ft, na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(df$elevation_ft, na.rm = TRUE),
                  length.out = 100)

  # Prediction data

    elevation_ft_scaled = (elev_seq - mean_elev)/sd_elev,
    diameter_complete_scaled = 0,
    predawn_scaled = 0,
    canopy_closure_scaled = 0
  )

  newdata$elevation <- elev_seq
  newdata$pred <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif <- signif_label

  all_preds_2D <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds_2D, newdata)
}
```

```{r}
  newdata$signif <- signif_label
```

```{r}
all_preds_3C <- data.frame()
model_summaries_3C <- data.frame()

  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    mod <- lmer(HSM_predawn_P50_mean ~ diameter_complete_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled +
                  (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df)

    mod <- lmer(HSM_predawn_P50_mean ~ diameter_complete_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled +
                  elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df)
  }

  # Extract fixed-effect p-value for canopy closure
  summ <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  cc_p <- summ["canopy_closure_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  cc_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",

                                      data.frame(species = sp,

  # Compute mean and SD for scaling percent cover
  mean_cc <- mean(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_cc   <- sd(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Sequence of percent cover values
  cc_seq <- seq(min(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE),

  # Prediction data

      diameter_complete_scaled = 0
    )

      elevation_ft_scaled = 0
    )
```

```{r}
### Figure 4A: Internode length by diameter
## plotting model fit trend lines and raw data points

all_preds_4A <- data.frame()
model_summaries_4A <- data.frame()

for (sp in names(species_list)) {
  df <- species_list[[sp]]
  
  # Fit species-specific model
  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    mod <- lmer(internode_length_1_2 ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled + HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + (1|plot),
                data = df)
  } else {
    mod <- lmer(internode_length_1_2 ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled + HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot),
                data = df)
  }
  
  # Extract fixed-effect p-value for diameter
  summ <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  if ("diameter_complete_scaled" %in% rownames(summ)) {
    diam_p <- summ["diameter_complete_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  } else {
    diam_p <- NA
  }
   signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  diam_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
  diam_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
  TRUE          ~ "Not significant"
)
  
   model_summaries_4A <- dplyr::bind_rows(model_summaries_4A,
                                       data.frame(species = sp,
                                                  p_value = diam_p,
                                                  signif = signif_label))
  
  # Sequence of diameter values 
  mean_diam <- mean(df$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_diam <- sd(df$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE)
  diam_seq <- seq(min(df$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(df$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
                  length.out = 100)
  
  # Create new data with scaled diameter varying and others held constant
  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    newdata <- data.frame(
      diameter_complete_scaled = (diam_seq - mean_diam) / sd_diam,
      predawn_scaled = 0,
      canopy_closure_scaled = 0,
      HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled = 0
    )
  } else {
    newdata <- data.frame(
      diameter_complete_scaled = (diam_seq - mean_diam) / sd_diam,
      predawn_scaled = 0,
      canopy_closure_scaled = 0,
      elevation_ft_scaled = 0,
      HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled = 0
    )
  }
  
  # Predictions
  newdata$diameter_complete <- diam_seq

}
```

```{r}
all_preds_4B <- data.frame()

                  (1|plot), data = df)
  }

  # Extract fixed-effect p-value for predawn
  summ <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  pd_p <- summ["predawn_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]

                length.out = 100)

  if (sp == "ABMA") {

    )
  } else {
    newdata <- data.frame(
      predawn_scaled = (pd_seq - mean_pd)/sd_pd,
      canopy_closure_scaled = 0,
      elevation_ft_scaled = 0,
      diameter_complete_scaled = 0,
      HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled = 0
    )
  }

  newdata$predawn <- pd_seq
  newdata$pred <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif <- signif_label

  all_preds_4B <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds_4B, newdata)
}
```

```{r}
all_preds_4E <- data.frame()

    mod <- lmer(internode_length_1_2 ~ diameter_complete_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + predawn_scaled + HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled + (1|plot), data = df)
  } else {
    mod <- lmer(internode_length_1_2 ~ diameter_complete_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + predawn_scaled + HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled + elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot), data = df)
  }
  
  # Extract fixed-effect p-value for canopy closure
  summ <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  canopy_p <- summ["canopy_closure_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  canopy_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
  canopy_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
  TRUE          ~ "Not significant"
)

                                      data.frame(species = sp,
                                                 p_value = canopy_p,
                                                 signif = signif_label))
  
  # Compute mean and SD for scaling canopy closure
  mean_canopy <- mean(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_canopy   <- sd(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Sequence of canopy closure values
  canopy_seq <- seq(min(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE),
                    max(df$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE),

  # Prediction data

      diameter_complete_scaled = 0,
      predawn_scaled = 0,
      HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled = 0,
      canopy_closure_scaled = (canopy_seq - mean_canopy)/sd_canopy
    )
  } else {
    newdata <- data.frame(
      diameter_complete_scaled = 0,
      predawn_scaled = 0,
      canopy_closure_scaled = (canopy_seq - mean_canopy)/sd_canopy,
      elevation_ft_scaled = 0,
      HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled = 0
    )
  }
  
  newdata$canopy <- canopy_seq
  newdata$pred <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif <- signif_label
  
  all_preds_4E <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds_4E, newdata)
}
```

## partial residuals
### WP x diameter
```{r}
### FIGURE S2A: Predawn WP by size
## plotting model fit trend lines and partial residuals data points

all_preds_S2A <- data.frame()
all_partial_S2A <- data.frame()
model_summaries_S2A <- data.frame()

for (sp in names(species_list)) {
  df <- species_list[[sp]]
  
  # Filter to complete cases
  variables <- c("predawn_MPa_combined", "diameter_complete_scaled",
                 "canopy_closure_scaled")
  if (sp != "ABMA") variables <- c(variables, "elevation_ft_scaled")
  df_cc <- df[complete.cases(df[, variables]), ]
  
  # Fit species-specific model
  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    mod <- lmer(predawn_MPa_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df_cc)
  } else {
    mod <- lmer(predawn_MPa_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df_cc)
  }
  
  # Extract fixed-effect p-value for diameter
  summ <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  diam_p <- summ["diameter_complete_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    diam_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
    diam_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
    TRUE          ~ "Not significant"
  )
  
  model_summaries_S2A <- dplyr::bind_rows(model_summaries_S2A,
                                      data.frame(species = sp,
                                                 p_value = diam_p,
                                                 signif = signif_label))
  
  # Compute mean and SD for scaling diameter
  mean_d <- mean(df_cc$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_d   <- sd(df_cc$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Sequence of diameters
  diam_seq <- seq(min(df_cc$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(df_cc$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
                  length.out = 100)
  
  # Prediction data
  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    newdata <- data.frame(
      diameter_complete_scaled = (diam_seq - mean_d)/sd_d,
      canopy_closure_scaled = 0
    )
  } else {
    newdata <- data.frame(
      diameter_complete_scaled = (diam_seq - mean_d)/sd_d,
      canopy_closure_scaled = 0,
      elevation_ft_scaled = 0
    )
  }
  
  newdata$diameter_cm <- diam_seq
  newdata$pred <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif <- signif_label
  all_preds_S2A <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds_S2A, newdata)
  
  # Partial residuals
  beta_diam      <- fixef(mod)["diameter_complete_scaled"]
  beta_intercept <- fixef(mod)["(Intercept)"]
  df_cc$partial_resid <- beta_intercept +
                         beta_diam * df_cc$diameter_complete_scaled +
                         residuals(mod)
  df_cc$diameter_cm <- df_cc$diameter_complete
  df_cc$species     <- sp
  df_cc$signif      <- signif_label
  all_partial_S2A <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_partial_S2A, df_cc)
}


S2A <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data  = all_partial_S2A,
    aes(x = diameter_cm, y = -partial_resid, color = species),
    alpha = 0.15, size = 2, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = all_preds_S2A,
    aes(x = diameter_cm, y = -pred,
        color    = species,
        linetype = signif),
    linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Significant"     = "solid",
    "Marginal"        = "dashed",
    "Not significant" = "dotted"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Basal diameter (cm)",
    y = expression(Psi[predawn] ~ "(MPa)")
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "gray50", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.line        = element_blank(),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position  = "none"
  )

cor.test(all_partial_S2A$partial_resid, all_partial_S2A$elevation_ft_scaled)
```

```{r}
for (sp in names(species_list)) {
  df <- species_list[[sp]]

  df_cc <- df[complete.cases(df[, variables]), ]

  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    mod <- lmer(P50_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled +
                  canopy_closure_scaled + (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df_cc)
  } else {
    mod <- lmer(P50_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled +
                  canopy_closure_scaled + elevation_ft_scaled +
                  (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df_cc)
  }

  summ         <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  diam_p       <- summ["diameter_complete_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- case_when(
    diam_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
    diam_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
    TRUE          ~ "Not significant"
  )
  model_summaries_S3A <- bind_rows(model_summaries_S3A,
    data.frame(species = sp, p_value = diam_p, signif = signif_label))

  mean_d <- mean(df_cc$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_d   <- sd(df_cc$diameter_complete,   na.rm = TRUE)

  diam_seq <- seq(min(df_cc$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(df_cc$diameter_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
                  length.out = 100)
  newdata <- data.frame(
    diameter_complete_scaled = (diam_seq - mean_d) / sd_d,
    predawn_scaled           = 0,
    canopy_closure_scaled    = 0
  )
  if (sp != "ABMA") newdata$elevation_ft_scaled <- 0
  newdata$diameter_cm <- diam_seq

  if (sp == "ABMA") {

                  canopy_closure_scaled + (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df_cc)
  } else {
    mod <- lmer(P50_combined ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled +
                  canopy_closure_scaled + elevation_ft_scaled +
                  (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df_cc)
  }

  summ         <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  pd_p         <- summ["predawn_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- case_when(
    pd_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
    pd_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
```

```{r}
### FIGURE S4D: HSM (midday) by canopy closure
## plotting model fit trend lines and partial residuals data points

all_preds_S4D <- data.frame()
all_partial_S4D <- data.frame()
model_summaries_S4D <- data.frame()

for (sp in names(species_list)) {

  df <- species_list[[sp]]

  vars <- c("HSM_midday_P50_mean",
            "canopy_closure_scaled",
            "diameter_complete_scaled",
            "predawn_scaled")

  if (sp != "ABMA") vars <- c(vars, "elevation_ft_scaled")

  df_cc <- df[complete.cases(df[, vars]), ]

  if (sp == "ABMA") {
    mod <- lmer(HSM_midday_P50_mean ~ canopy_closure_scaled +
                  diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled +
                  (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df_cc)
  } else {
    mod <- lmer(HSM_midday_P50_mean ~ canopy_closure_scaled +
                  diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled +
                  elevation_ft_scaled +
                  (1|plot) + (1|wp_year), data = df_cc)
  }

  summ <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  pval <- summ["canopy_closure_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]

  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    pval < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
    pval < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
    TRUE        ~ "Not significant"
  )
  
  model_summaries_S4D <- dplyr::bind_rows(model_summaries_S4D,
                                        data.frame(species = sp,
                                                   p_value = pval,
                                                   signif = signif_label))

  mean_cc <- mean(df_cc$canopy_closure)
  sd_cc   <- sd(df_cc$canopy_closure)

  cc_seq <- seq(min(df_cc$canopy_closure),
                max(df_cc$canopy_closure),
                length.out = 100)

  newdata <- data.frame(
    canopy_closure_scaled = (cc_seq - mean_cc)/sd_cc,
    diameter_complete_scaled = 0,
    predawn_scaled = 0
  )
  if (sp != "ABMA") newdata$elevation_ft_scaled <- 0

  newdata$canopy_closure <- cc_seq
  newdata$pred <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif  <- signif_label

  all_preds_S4D <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds_S4D, newdata)

  beta <- fixef(mod)["canopy_closure_scaled"]
  intercept <- fixef(mod)["(Intercept)"]

  df_cc$partial_resid <- intercept +
                         beta * df_cc$canopy_closure_scaled +
                         residuals(mod)

  df_cc$canopy_closure_raw <- df_cc$canopy_closure
  df_cc$species <- sp
  df_cc$signif  <- signif_label

  all_partial_S4D <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_partial_S4D, df_cc)
}
```

```{r}
  }

  summ  <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  hsm_p <- summ["HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    hsm_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
    hsm_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
    TRUE         ~ "Not significant"
  )
  model_summaries_S5C <- dplyr::bind_rows(model_summaries_S5C,
                                         data.frame(species = sp, p_value = hsm_p, signif = signif_label))

  mean_hsm <- mean(df_cc$HSM_midday_P50_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_hsm   <- sd(df_cc$HSM_midday_P50_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  hsm_seq  <- seq(min(df_cc$HSM_midday_P50_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(df_cc$HSM_midday_P50_mean, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)

  newdata <- data.frame(HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled = (hsm_seq - mean_hsm)/sd_hsm,
                        predawn_scaled = 0, canopy_closure_scaled = 0, diameter_complete_scaled = 0)
  if (sp != "ABMA") newdata$elevation_ft_scaled <- 0
  newdata$HSM_midday_P50_mean <- hsm_seq
  newdata$pred    <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif  <- signif_label
  all_preds_S5C <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds_S5C, newdata)

  beta_hsm       <- fixef(mod)["HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled"]
  beta_intercept <- fixef(mod)["(Intercept)"]
  df_cc$partial_resid <- beta_intercept +
                         beta_hsm * df_cc$HSM_midday_P50_mean_scaled +
                         residuals(mod)
  df_cc$HSM_midday_P50_mean <- df_cc$HSM_midday_P50_mean
  df_cc$species  <- sp
  df_cc$signif   <- signif_label
  all_partial_S5C <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_partial_S5C, df_cc)
}

S5C <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = all_partial_S5C,
             aes(x = HSM_midday_P50_mean, y = partial_resid, color = species),
             alpha = 0.15, size = 2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_line(data = all_preds_S5C,
            aes(x = HSM_midday_P50_mean, y = pred, color = species, linetype = signif),
            linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Significant" = "solid", "Marginal" = "dashed", "Not significant" = "dotted")) +
  labs(x = expression(HSM[midday]~"(MPa)"), y = "Internode length (cm)") +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.border     = element_rect(color = "gray50", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.position  = "none")

### FIGURE S5D: Internode length by P50 
## plotting model fit trend lines and partial residuals data points
all_preds_S5D   <- data.frame()
all_partial_S5D <- data.frame()
model_summaries_S5D <- data.frame()

for (sp in names(species_list)) {
  df <- species_list[[sp]]

  vars <- c("internode_length_1_2", "P50_scaled", "diameter_complete_scaled",
            "predawn_scaled", "canopy_closure_scaled")
  if (sp != "ABMA") vars <- c(vars, "elevation_ft_scaled")
  df_cc <- df[complete.cases(df[, vars]), ]

  mod <- if (sp == "ABMA") {
    lmer(internode_length_1_2 ~ diameter_complete_scaled + P50_scaled +
           predawn_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + (1|plot), data = df_cc)
  } else {
    lmer(internode_length_1_2 ~ diameter_complete_scaled + P50_scaled +
           predawn_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled + elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot), data = df_cc)
  }

  summ  <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  p50_p <- summ["P50_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    p50_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
    p50_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
    TRUE         ~ "Not significant"
  )
  model_summaries_S5D <- dplyr::bind_rows(model_summaries_S5D,
                                         data.frame(species = sp, p_value = p50_p, signif = signif_label))

  mean_P50 <- mean(df_cc$P50_combined, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_P50   <- sd(df_cc$P50_combined, na.rm = TRUE)
  P50_seq  <- seq(min(df_cc$P50_combined, na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(df_cc$P50_combined, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)

  newdata <- data.frame(P50_scaled = (P50_seq - mean_P50)/sd_P50,
                        diameter_complete_scaled = 0, predawn_scaled = 0, canopy_closure_scaled = 0)
  if (sp != "ABMA") newdata$elevation_ft_scaled <- 0
  newdata$P50_raw <- P50_seq
  newdata$pred    <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif  <- signif_label
  all_preds_S5D <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds_S5D, newdata)

  beta_p50       <- fixef(mod)["P50_scaled"]
  beta_intercept <- fixef(mod)["(Intercept)"]
  df_cc$partial_resid <- beta_intercept +
                         beta_p50 * df_cc$P50_scaled +
                         residuals(mod)
  df_cc$P50_raw  <- df_cc$P50_combined
  df_cc$species  <- sp
  df_cc$signif   <- signif_label
  all_partial_S5D <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_partial_S5D, df_cc)
}

S5D <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = all_partial_S5D,
             aes(x = P50_raw, y = partial_resid, color = species),
             alpha = 0.15, size = 2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_line(data = all_preds_S5D,
            aes(x = P50_raw, y = pred, color = species, linetype = signif),
            linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Significant" = "solid", "Marginal" = "dashed", "Not significant" = "dotted")) +
  scale_x_reverse(labels = function(x) paste0("\u2212", abs(x))) +
  labs(x = expression(P[50]~"(MPa)"), y = "Internode length (cm)") +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.border     = element_rect(color = "gray50", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.position  = "none")

### FIGURE S5E: Internode length by canopy closure 
## plotting model fit trend lines and partial residuals data points
all_preds_S5E   <- data.frame()
all_partial_S5E <- data.frame()
model_summaries_S5E <- data.frame()

for (sp in names(species_list)) {
  df <- species_list[[sp]]

  vars <- c("internode_length_1_2", "canopy_closure_scaled",
            "diameter_complete_scaled", "predawn_scaled")
  if (sp != "ABMA") vars <- c(vars, "elevation_ft_scaled")
  df_cc <- df[complete.cases(df[, vars]), ]

  mod <- if (sp == "ABMA") {
    lmer(internode_length_1_2 ~ diameter_complete_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled +
           predawn_scaled + (1|plot), data = df_cc)
  } else {
    lmer(internode_length_1_2 ~ diameter_complete_scaled + canopy_closure_scaled +
           predawn_scaled + elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot), data = df_cc)
  }

  summ     <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  canopy_p <- summ["canopy_closure_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    canopy_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
    canopy_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
    TRUE            ~ "Not significant"
  )
  model_summaries_S5E <- dplyr::bind_rows(model_summaries_S5E,
                                         data.frame(species = sp, p_value = canopy_p, signif = signif_label))

  mean_canopy <- mean(df_cc$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE)

  canopy_seq  <- seq(min(df_cc$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE),
                     max(df_cc$canopy_closure, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)

  newdata <- data.frame(canopy_closure_scaled = (canopy_seq - mean_canopy)/sd_canopy,
                        diameter_complete_scaled = 0, predawn_scaled = 0)
  if (sp != "ABMA") newdata$elevation_ft_scaled <- 0
  newdata$canopy  <- canopy_seq
  newdata$pred    <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif  <- signif_label

                         beta_canopy * df_cc$canopy_closure_scaled +

  df_cc$canopy   <- df_cc$canopy_closure
  df_cc$species  <- sp
  df_cc$signif   <- signif_label
  all_partial_S5E <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_partial_S5E, df_cc)
}

S5E <- ggplot() +

### FIGURE S5F: Internode length by elevation 
## plotting model fit trend lines and partial residuals data points
all_preds_S5F   <- data.frame()
all_partial_S5F <- data.frame()
model_summaries_S5F <- data.frame()

for (sp in names(species_list_elev)) {
  df <- species_list_elev[[sp]]

  vars <- c("internode_length_1_2", "elevation_ft_scaled",
            "diameter_complete_scaled", "predawn_scaled", "canopy_closure_scaled")
  df_cc <- df[complete.cases(df[, vars]), ]

  mod <- lmer(internode_length_1_2 ~ diameter_complete_scaled + predawn_scaled +
                canopy_closure_scaled + elevation_ft_scaled + (1|plot), data = df_cc)

  summ   <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  elev_p <- summ["elevation_ft_scaled", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  signif_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    elev_p < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
    elev_p < 0.1  ~ "Marginal",
    TRUE          ~ "Not significant"
  )
  model_summaries_S5F <- dplyr::bind_rows(model_summaries_S5F,
                                         data.frame(species = sp, p_value = elev_p, signif = signif_label))

  mean_elev <- mean(df_cc$elevation_ft, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_elev   <- sd(df_cc$elevation_ft, na.rm = TRUE)
  elev_seq  <- seq(min(df_cc$elevation_ft, na.rm = TRUE),
                   max(df_cc$elevation_ft, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)

  newdata <- data.frame(elevation_ft_scaled     = (elev_seq - mean_elev)/sd_elev,
                        diameter_complete_scaled = 0,
                        predawn_scaled           = 0,
                        canopy_closure_scaled    = 0)
  newdata$elev    <- elev_seq
  newdata$pred    <- predict(mod, newdata, re.form = NA)
  newdata$species <- sp
  newdata$signif  <- signif_label
  all_preds_S5F <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds_S5F, newdata)

  beta_elev      <- fixef(mod)["elevation_ft_scaled"]
  beta_intercept <- fixef(mod)["(Intercept)"]
  df_cc$partial_resid <- beta_intercept +
                         beta_elev * df_cc$elevation_ft_scaled +
                         residuals(mod)
  df_cc$elev     <- df_cc$elevation_ft
  df_cc$species  <- sp
  df_cc$signif   <- signif_label
  all_partial_S5F <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_partial_S5F, df_cc)
}

S5F <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = all_partial_S5F,
```
